import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[][] dp;
    static int N, H;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        N = sc.nextInt();
        H = sc.nextInt();

        dp = new long[N + 1][N + 1];

        // Initialize DP table
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) {
                    dp[i][j] = 1;
                } else if (i == 0 || j == 0) {
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    dp[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }

        // Fill DP table iteratively to avoid StackOverflow and match the Python logic
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                calculateT(i, j);
            }
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = H; i <= N; i++) {
            totalSum += dp[N][i];
        }
        System.out.println(totalSum);
    }

    static long calculateT(int n, int h) {
        if (dp[n][h] != -1) {
            return dp[n][h];
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; m++) {
            // Part 1: t(m-1, h-1) * sum(t(n-m, i) for i in range(h))
            long sum1 = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                sum1 += calculateT(n - m, i);
            }
            result += calculateT(m - 1, h - 1) * sum1;

            // Part 2: t(n-m, h-1) * sum(t(m-1, i) for i in range(h-1))
            long sum2 = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < h - 1; i++) {
                sum2 += calculateT(m - 1, i);
            }
            result += calculateT(n - m, h - 1) * sum2;
        }

        dp[n][h] = result;
        return result;
    }
}
